fieldValues.title: A boundary is drawn around what is being worked on, and every read stays inside it
fieldValues.move: A writer or agent draws a boundary around the work in hand (a conversation, an essay, one aspect of a domain) and search, traversal, context and views can each be limited to it. The cost of building and working inside a boundary is measured, so a slow one is noticed.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Whether relations become container-specific (they are not today), and the choice of boundary for a family of essays.
fieldValues.falsifier: Working on one aspect of a large repository, the owner still filters results by hand because a read ignores the boundary.
